Why Our AI Suite Makes Your Store More 
Profitable
Turn every shopper interaction into a conversion opportunity.
Our AI Suite delivers personalized guidance, simplifies product decisions, and keeps customers engaged, so they stay longer and buy more.
Conversational AI that sells
An on-site assistant that answers real shopper questions clearly and instantly – reducing uncertainty, building trust, and converting hesitant buyers just like an in-store expert.
Personalized experiences that convert
Engage each shopper with tailored recommendations, banners, pop-ups, and emails based on real-time behavior. From first visit to post-purchase.
Smarter product discovery
Our AI replaces clunky filters with guided discovery – matching shoppers to the right products faster, boosting visibility across your catalog. Helping customers discover more, and buy more.
Simplified comparison and decision-making
Make it easier for shoppers to evaluate options and choose the right product with side-by-side AI-powered comparisons and contextual Q&A.
Unlock customer insights with AI
By analyzing shopper behavior and real on-site questions, our AI tracks intent signals, identifies content gaps, and spots friction points – revealing exactly what your customers are looking for, and what’s holding them back.
Keeps shoppers on your site
Our AI-powered solutions eliminate the need for customers to search elsewhere – reducing bounce rates and drop-offs to Google, ChatGPT, or competitor websites.

Frequently Asked Questions
How do you prevent inaccurate or irrelevant answers?
Our AI is purpose-built to answer product-related questions – not to generate generic fluff. On top of that, we run weekly quality audits in the background to ensure all responses are appropriate, trustworthy, and free of competitor mentions or off-brand content.
What kind of questions can the AI answer?
The AI can handle product-specific questions (e.g., size, specs, compatibility), policy-related queries (e.g., returns, shipping), and even product comparisons – all based on your existing data.
Will it slow down my website?
No. AI Product Expert is designed to load asynchronously and has no impact on site performance.
Can I customize the look and feel of the widget?
Yes! The widget can be fully customized to match your store’s branding and tone.
What if I want the assistant to match my brand’s tone?
You’re in control. You can fully customize the assistant’s tone and communication style to align with your brand – from professional to playful, or anything in between.
Is it compatible with other support tools or chatbots?
Yes. AI Product Expert can run alongside your existing chat or support tools without conflict.
What kind of analytics will I get?
You’ll see what customers are asking, which products generate the most questions, and where content gaps may exist – helping you optimize your store.
Does it comply with GDPR and other data regulations?
Yes, our solution is fully compliant with GDPR and other major data privacy regulations. We do not store or share personal customer data, and all interactions are processed securely in accordance with industry best practices. You remain in full control of the data collected on your site.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I upgrade or downgrade later?
Yes. You can switch plans at any time as your business grows or your needs change. We’ll help you make the transition smooth and seamless.
 Is there a long-term commitment?
No. We offer flexible, monthly billing with no long-term contracts. Cancel or change your plan at any time.
Do you offer custom plans for large or unique stores?
Absolutely. If your store has specific needs, high traffic, or complex use cases, we’ll work with you to build a custom plan tailored to your business.
Is there a discount for annual plans?
Yes, we reward customers who opt for an annual subscription with a discount. This option helps you save money while enjoying our services.
Do you offer onboarding assistance for new customers?
Absolutely! We provide collateral-based onboarding assistance and resources to ensure you get the most out of our services from day one.
